system.description:
• Effect: Use Fascinate while performing: all listeners must make a Will save or be held in rapture, unable to leave while the Bard performs, and remain held until the end of their next turn after you stop.
  • Affects up to 20 Levels of targets — lowest Level first
  • Affects any humanoid regardless of language
  • Scales: 40 Levels at 16th, 80 Levels at 19th, 160 Levels at 22nd
